name: Hibiscus Petroleum Berhad
overview: 2026 年公司公告主要为股息派发、公司秘书变更及地址变更等事项，未披露任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或合约签订。最新季度营收同比增长 34.5%，净利润同比增长 155.6%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company's announcements mainly covered dividend payments, changes of company secretary, and change of address; no business segment expansion, new business, reduction, divestment, or contract awards were disclosed. Latest quarterly revenue grew 34.5% year-on-year and net profit grew 155.6% year-on-year.
